fields.status: DEPLOYED (commissioning complete per QuantumCTek's 2025 annual report, Mar 2026)
fields.gate_mechanism: tunable coupler; explicitly a Zuchongzhi 3.0-like architecture; iSWAP-like (fSim) two-qubit gate at a fixed 40 ns, single-qubit gates 26 ns with DRAG (arXiv:2512.10504); the cloud's native gate set in the owner SDK: RZ, X2P, X2M, Y2P, Y2M, XY2P, XY2M, CZ (cqlib-tianyan device_config.rs, Sep 2026); the AshN scheme (simultaneous XY drives on both qubits with the tunable coupler) gives a native set of CZ 48 ns, iSWAP 44 ns, √iSWAP 28 ns, SWAP 60 ns and a B-like gate 44 ns on the 105-qubit, 182-coupler device of arXiv:2608.24084 (CTQG with Tsinghua, Aug 2026; the paper names the architecture, not the machine)
fields.connectivity: square grid lattice, 105 qubits and 182 couplers (the owner's wording, arXiv:2512.10504)
fields.control: room-temperature RF; per-qubit XY and Z lines combined at room temperature through a bias tee before the refrigerator, coupler lines routed separately (arXiv:2608.24084)
fields.readout: dispersive; X12-gate-driven 0–2 readout, correlated readout errors below 2 % with a synchronous SPAM protocol (arXiv:2512.10504); a TWPA at the mixing-chamber stage and a HEMT at 4 K (arXiv:2608.24084)
fields.err_2q_median: 4.4e-3 mean iSWAP-like (fSim) Pauli error, simultaneous XEB (74-qubit RCS subset; 99.56%); the same 4.4 ‰ mean over all 105 qubits operating simultaneously; no median published (arXiv:2512.10504)
fields.demonstrated_algorithms: RCS, 74 q x 24 cycles, 1e6 samples in 18.4 minutes vs ~16,000 years classically; an 8-qubit two-excitation Dicke state at fidelity 0.736 ± 0.001 with genuine multipartite entanglement certified, compiled to the AshN native gates (CZ-only compilation 0.631, not certified), on the 105-qubit device of arXiv:2608.24084 (Aug 2026)

chip coherence per the owner paper: «The qubits have a mean operating T1 of 44.4 μs and T2^CPMG of 41.1 μs» (all 105 qubits; 104 working — one non-functional, two TLS-suppressed); the paper gives the 74-qubit subset's T2^CPMG as 44.1 μs in the text and 41.1 μs in the Fig. S2 label (an internal inconsistency, left to the owner); reliability monitored 29 Aug – 28 Sep 2025. Not put in the t1/t2 cells: a ledger statement per the findings file.

ICV TA&K, 2026 Global Quantum Computing Cloud Platform Evaluation Report (tests Jan–Jul 2026, 7 platforms): the Tianyan Quantum Computing Cloud Platform 72.5 points, Tier 1 with the IBM Quantum Platform (80.3); «Powered by the self-developed Tianyan-287 superconducting chip», «supports 26-qubit global GHZ entanglement», «achieves an 11-qubit XEB fidelity of 0.652» (press, re-read 15 Oct 2026)

the owner counts «five systems in operation» on the Tianyan cloud in Dec 2025 — Tianyan-287, Tianyan-176, Tianyan-176 II, Tianyan-504, Tianyan-24, «equipped with Zuchongzhi- and Xiaohong- series superconducting quantum processors» (arXiv:2512.10504); the photonic Tianyan-P2000 joined the cloud in June 2026 («此前，“天衍”量子计算云平台已成功并网5台超导量子计算机», C114 via 新浪科技, 22 Jun 2026); the SDK's device table of Sep 2026 lists a sixth superconducting backend, tianyan-294, that no announcement names

«In 2024, the platform delivered a 504 qubits superconducting quantum system, marking the first validation of a 504-qubit-scale system» (arXiv:2512.10504); no calibration, coherence, fidelity or uptime figure published as of 15 Oct 2026; the SDK's download_config for tianyan504 answers only to a token (the reader of 15 Oct got HTTP 401)

the owner's Cqlib tutorial (Aug 2024): T1 34.2 µs, T2 3.09 µs, readout error 5.98 %, 1Q error 0.18 %, 2Q error 1.92 % («天衍-176性能卓越，具有66个量子比特，110个纠缠比特，平均相干时间T1为34.2微秒，T2为3.09微秒。其读出错误率为5.98%，单比特门错误率为0.18%，双比特门错误率为1.92%»); third-party users for 1–27 May 2026: median T1 27.89 µs, T2 (CPMG) 21.61 µs, 1Q error 1.4e-3, 2Q error 1.36e-2, readout error 2.95e-2 (arXiv:2609.32433). Coherence not put in the t1/t2 cells: a ledger statement per the findings file.

status_date: keep Oct 2025 or move to Nov 2025 — the owner monitored the machine running from 29 Aug 2025 (arXiv:2512.10504); QuantumCTek announced it «正式运行» on 19 Nov 2025; the Oct 2025 date rests on a Xinhua item of 12 Oct 2025 read only in paraphrase. Not edited: the editor's (the cohort date).
